ui-craft directions

Sixteen visual directions. Each is a small theme file in this folder: colours (contrast-checked, light and dark), fonts, shape, depth and motion. Pick the one that fits the audience, then swap in the brand colour.

calm-productivity.css

Calm productivity

General SaaS, project and task tools, calendars, CRMs, internal apps. The safe default when no other direction clearly fits.

Clear, friendly, capable. Nothing shouts.

One satisfying completion moment (a check that draws itself, a row that settles) and beautifully calm lists.
